nodes.text: Strep & iGAS has been surging at record levels since late 2022. The CDC blamed “the lifting of pandemic restrictions & reduced exposure to GAS” for the surges. As folks end up with sepsis, quadruple amputations, & bacterial meningitis, all of our wounds are self inflicted. 🧵 COVID + strep coinfections do bad things to the brain.

nodes.text: @FermentiLlc Thank you, I know it’s heavy, but I’ve been watching in horror as these people lie & get away with it because there’s SO MUCH DISEASE, the public can’t keep up.

nodes.author: FermentiLlc
nodes.text: @LauraMiers I know! It's such a tragedy how our most vulnerable and low info public is being and have been abused. I finally had enough in 2020 and started speaking out in my field so respect to you because I know how it limits your profession doing so. 👍👍

nodes.author: LauraMiers
nodes.text: @FermentiLlc Agreed. I can say whatever I want because there is no career at stake. I have been too sick to work since Covid disabled me in 2020, & I doubt I will ever work again. I’m very privileged to have family help & to not have to rely on a job for survival, as it lets me be free.

nodes.author: FermentiLlc
nodes.text: @LauraMiers Thank you for what your doing. You have a really good drumbeat on going at the links. Covid messed me up/fatigue to the point I sold my construction business and started one that focuses on making food that helps the damage it did to my gut. Not fixed by any means but helps alot.
